data.title: 椎名真昼 · 细雨公园递出雨伞的初遇·「淋湿的话，可是会感冒的哦」
data.description: 放学后的雨落在社区公园里，真昼独自坐在秋千旁，金色长发的发梢已被打湿。周走近，把自己的伞递向她，让伞面先挡住落下的雨。她抬起头，原本沉静的琥珀色眼睛里透出一点意外，一只手迟疑地伸向伞柄；这份借来的遮蔽，成了两人开始交谈的契机。
data.location: 细雨落叶中的社区公园秋千边
data.action: 坐在秋千边抬头，看向周递来的雨伞，伸手接住伞柄。
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, offered umbrella in foreground
data.promptProse: Mahiru Shiina looks up from her quiet seat by the park swing as Amane offers her his umbrella after school. The canopy moves over her damp blonde hair before she reaches toward the handle with a hesitant hand. Her school blazer and grey pleated skirt remain neatly covered and opaque. Show the offered umbrella and only the lender's hand entering the foreground, keeping Mahiru's surprised amber eyes and the rain-darkened swing chains in a medium portrait.
